evidence_gaps: Fresh runtime forensics generated within two hours.
Confirmed per-attempt Solana and EVM receipts/signatures, statuses, timestamps and wallet-bound balance deltas.
Cost decomposition for DEX/pool fees, slippage, price impact, gas or priority fees, builder payments, platform fees, fee-settlement gas and Solana account rent/refunds.
Capital-at-risk and holding-time denominators needed for money-weighted and capital-time returns.
Immutable pre-trade quotes, quote age, requested versus filled amounts, minimum outputs and post-trade reconciliation.
Separate counts and costs for simulation rejection, RPC failure, broadcast failure, dropped/reverted transaction, landed-invalid output and reconciliation failure.
Out-of-sample results by chain, route, asset, size, market regime and congestion regime.
Solana contemporaneous sellability/liquidity and fixed-horizon executable exit quotes.
EVM nonce/replacement and pending-transaction outcomes sufficient to exclude duplicate or unresolved executions.
Profit-fee settlement completion and retained user net after settlement transaction costs.

Before any promotion: cost-complete, reconciled, held-out evidence satisfying the proposal-specific minimum observations with positive lower-confidence money-weighted net and bounded execution-failure rates.

proposals.downside_risk: Slower promotion and fewer trades; this is preferable to deploying capital on statistically fragile evidence.

evidence.detail: Promotion uses only 3 trades for CANARY-to-PROBATION and 8 for PROBATION-to-ACTIVE, aggregates state by strategy name, and compares absolute native-token P&L without chain, notional, return, observation-time or regime separation.
AI decisions marked shadow_only can authorize the real-money CANARY policy; no mandatory realised out-of-sample SHADOW evidence is checked in route_canary_policy.
Runtime forensics are unavailable, so there is no fresh realised evidence supporting promotion.

proposals.expected_effect: Prevent unsupported promotion and rank strategies by net return on deployed capital after every execution cost, separately by chain, route and regime.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 eligible out-of-sample observations and 20 cost-complete outcomes across at least 3 independent windows per chain/route family, including adverse-volatility and congestion periods; then require a separately held-out confirmation window.
proposals.rationale: A few positive trades or a large winner can promote a strategy despite weak money-weighted evidence, chain-specific cost differences or concentrated regime exposure. Solana and EVM native amounts are not economically comparable.
proposals.shadow_test: In SHADOW, require pre-registered walk-forward windows and compute confirmed or executable-counterfactual net P&L divided by capital-time, including all chain-specific costs. Stop and rework if cumulative net is non-positive, profit factor is at most 1, lower-confidence expected net is non-positive, any cost field is missing, or execution failures exceed the preset bound. Do not pool SOL, ETH, BNB or POL amounts without contemporaneous valuation.

proposals.downside_risk: Historical scorecards may become less favorable and some outcomes will remain pending until reconciliation.

evidence.detail: Recorder converts realised net into gross-profit/gross-loss fields while recording fees and slippage as zero, losing the cost decomposition required for attribution.
SUCCESS_FEE_PENDING and BROADCAST are accepted as executed outcomes, and missing realised_net_base falls back to expected_net_base; rejected/failing attempts are not recorded as execution failures.
realised_net_base subtracts cycle gas but profit_fee_base is separate; fee-settlement transaction gas and pending fee settlement are not included in retained user net.
record_window accepts caller-supplied net_profit without enforcing gross_profit minus gross_loss minus all recorded costs.
Solana explicitly distinguishes landed-invalid-output faults and wallet reconciliation state, but this failure detail is not represented in the common Strategy Lab windows.

proposals.expected_effect: Produce auditable, money-weighted retained net P&L after DEX fees, slippage, impact, gas/priority fees, platform fees, settlement gas, rent effects and failed-attempt costs.
proposals.minimum_observation: Reconcile 100% of at least 30 recent attempts per active chain, including successes, reverts, dropped transactions, landed-invalid outputs and fee-settlement failures; zero unexplained material balance deltas.
proposals.rationale: Expected or merely broadcast results are not realised P&L. Collapsing costs into net prevents diagnosis of STRATEGY/MARKET loss versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure and can overstate end-user profitability.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay a SHADOW ledger against immutable execution records. Count P&L only after confirmed receipt/signature and balance reconciliation; keep BROADCAST and fee-pending rows pending. Verify net equals proceeds minus principal and every explicit cost. Classify negative reconciled trades as STRATEGY/MARKET and preflight, RPC, broadcast, landing, receipt or reconciliation faults as EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE. Fail the test on any expected-value fallback, unexplained balance delta or classification ambiguity.
proposals.strategy: Direct Market Arbitrage and Leader Copy measurement

proposals.downside_risk: Most Solana signals may correctly abstain because future-return evidence is insufficient.

evidence.detail: Solana leader observations deliberately set gross edge, liquidity and sellability to zero and mark outcomes SIGNAL_ONLY_MISSING_CURRENT_EXECUTABLE_EDGE.
LIVE entry economics use observed historical overhead and leader-quality gates, but do not produce a contemporaneous expected round-trip net-edge forecast for Strategy Lab.
Jupiter order simulation and post-execution validation provide useful execution evidence, but entry alone cannot prove future sell-side edge.

proposals.expected_effect: Measure whether leader-copy signals retain executable follower edge without forcing trades and without weakening current sellability or execution protections.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 independent leader signals across at least 10 mints and 3 congestion regimes, with cost-complete entry and exit counterfactuals, plus explicit no-quote and unsellable outcomes.
proposals.rationale: Historical leader profitability and a successful buy simulation do not prove that a delayed follower can exit profitably after Jupiter routing, price impact, priority fees, account rent and leader-copy latency.
proposals.shadow_test: At signal time, record immutable buy and sell quotes at the proposed size, route, impact, priority fee, account/rent reserve and leader-copy latency. Re-quote at predeclared horizons and leader exit, using executable minimum outputs. Stop the hypothesis if cost-complete cumulative money-weighted net is non-positive, sell quotes become unavailable, failure rate breaches the preset limit, or results depend on stale/unreproducible quotes.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote a strategy because it has a high win rate or three to eight profitable trades.
rejected_ideas.reason: Win count is not money-weighted net profitability and the sample is too small and regime-concentrated.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat successful simulation, BROADCAST status or expected net edge as realised profit.
rejected_ideas.reason: These omit landing, reconciliation, settlement and adverse execution outcomes.

rejected_ideas.idea: Lower liquidity, sellability, simulation, wallet, reserve, stop-loss or reconciliation gates to increase participation.
rejected_ideas.reason: Higher trade count cannot compensate for non-executable edge and would weaken capital protection.

rejected_ideas.idea: Claim host-wide network counters as bot-only bandwidth evidence.
rejected_ideas.reason: No attribution evidence is available, and host-wide counters are not bot-specific.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository contains strong fail-closed quote, simulation, liquidity, sellability and reconciliation protections, but current Strategy Lab and canary accounting cannot yet establish durable money-weighted net profitability. In particular, EVM records can omit platform-fee settlement costs and treat BROADCAST/expected results as outcomes, while lifecycle aggregation mixes native-token amounts without notional-normalised returns. Solana Strategy Lab correctly lacks current executable-edge evidence and must remain SHADOW/DORMANT. STRATEGY/MARKET losses must be measured from confirmed, reconciled executions or fixed-horizon executable counterfactuals; RPC, simulation, broadcast, landing, receipt and reconciliation faults must remain separate EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures. No profitability, CANARY-readiness or LIVE-readiness claim is supported.
